verdict.rationale: The API and dedicated Agents CLI allow programmatic, non-interactive creation/configuration of agents, and the agent-testing feature explicitly supports running conversational test suites before deployment, which is consistent with CI-style automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of a headless runtime mode, CI/CD pipeline integration, or example of running tests in an automated build environment. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, documented headless execution mode, and evidence of automated test runs in a build system.
